title: The Joe 10 forward test
description: A pre-registered, daily-updated forward test of the Joe 10, Tangent Atlas's generic model of a personal index: the 10 largest US companies by full market value, Constant Weight, with its cash reset daily to hold 15% volatility. Compared with SPY and with SPY plus cash at the same risk. The rules and predictions are frozen before the first day; each monthly version adds results only. Version 1.0 froze a forward test of the Ken 11 (an illustration), withdrawn before its first close. Hypothetical performance; not investment advice.
